propositions: The documented curl command using git rev-parse --git-path hooks/commit-msg from a linked worktree resolves to and overwrites the shared hook in the main checkout, clobbering the pre-commit wrapper for all worktrees.
Running the unsafe curl breaks Change-Id stamping silently at commit time but only surfaces as a Gerrit push rejection in a potentially different worktree many commits later.
The pre-commit wrapper in MIGRATION mode preserves Gerrit's hook as commit-msg.legacy and chains both, but curl overwrites the wrapper entirely rather than chaining to it.
The fix consolidates hook installation into a single idempotent documented path (make hooks) with a new worktree-safe script that installs to commit-msg.legacy when a pre-commit wrapper exists.
AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md must remove all bare curl instructions targeting $(git rev-parse --git-path hooks/commit-msg) and document only make hooks.
The new installer validates payloads, refuses unsafe overwrites of non-wrapper hooks, and works identically from main checkout, subdirectory, or linked worktree.
